mechanism: Task-local subprocess.Popen(start_new_session=True) with stdin/out/err detached; actual controlling SSH exited, new connect.sh session read the saved original job.
clock_note: Remote and local system clocks differ by approximately7m40s; elapsed compute times use the remote clock only.
scope: Real SSH disconnect/reconnect and saved-job/result continuation for one ONNX output check. This does not mean AI reasoning continues after its host session closes.
